name: tracktime-raycast
title: tracktime
description: Start, stop and edit tracktime timers from Raycast, with a live menu bar clock.
author: trebeljahr

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Timer
commands.subtitle: tracktime
commands.description: Show the running timer in the macOS menu bar.

preferences.name: titleMode
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.description: What the menu bar shows while a timer runs.

preferences.name: hideWhenIdle
preferences.title: Idle
preferences.label: Hide the menu bar item when no timer runs
preferences.description: Keeps the menu bar clean; the item reappears on the next start.

commands.name: start-timer
commands.title: Start Timer
commands.subtitle: tracktime
commands.description: Start a new timer, optionally on a project and task.

commands.name: start-favorite
commands.title: Start a Favorite
commands.subtitle: tracktime
commands.description: Start a pinned favorite or something you tracked recently.

commands.name: stop-timer
commands.title: Stop Timer
commands.subtitle: tracktime
commands.description: Stop the running timer and keep the entry.

commands.name: toggle-timer
commands.title: Toggle Timer
commands.subtitle: tracktime
commands.description: Stop the running timer, or resume the most recent entry.

commands.name: entries
commands.title: Time Entries
commands.subtitle: tracktime
commands.description: Browse, continue, edit and delete recent time entries.

commands.name: sign-in
commands.title: Sign in to tracktime
commands.subtitle: tracktime
commands.description: Pair Raycast with your tracktime account using a device code.

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: API URL
preferences.description: Origin of the tracktime server, e.g. https://api.tracktime.example.

preferences.name: webUrl
preferences.title: Web App URL
preferences.description: Origin of the tracktime web app, used for the device-pairing page and Open in Browser.
